skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants a custom travel itinerary / 旅行攻略 / 行程规划 / 自由行攻略 that is actually executable — where every hotel, restaurant, attraction and route comes with a clickable link that jumps straight to Ctrip (携程), Amap (高德地图) or Dianping (大众点评) so the user can compare prices and book immediately. It also computes real point-to-point distances between stops, writes the public-transit strategy (metro/bus lines, transfers, exits) or driving-and-parking notes, offers navigation links for driving/transit/walking, and gives at least three restaurant options per meal grouped by nearby district so the user never has to travel far to eat. Trigger it whenever the user says things like "帮我做个X天X城的攻略", "定制旅行计划", "行程规划", "想去XX玩几天", "做个攻略，酒店美食要有链接可以点开下单", "景点之间的距离和交通也写出来", "餐厅多给几家、要景点附近的", or complains that AI itineraries are useless because they never tell you what to actually book or how far apart things are.
